finding: Window checkpoint queries did not recheck cancellation after an asynchronous batch commit; sort scopes did detect cancellation there.
changes: Shared batch helper accepts a query budget check before staging, before commit and after commit.
Window and sort supply their existing query budget checks.
Batch contract explicitly preserves successfully published data when cancellation arrives during commit.

new_cases: Sort and window commits are held in flight, the query is cancelled, and commit is allowed to succeed. Both queries report LAKEQL_ABORTED, both checkpoint files remain published, and query reservations return to zero.

remaining: Commit cannot be retracted after successful publication; callers must not interpret cancellation as proof of no side effect.
No cloud spill adapter atomicity or total Worker heap claim follows from controlled in-memory fixtures.
